brief: Prioritise Ivybridge Green for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with high loading histories have reduced margins against mechanical failure under heat events, as detailed in MG-023. Where such a unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period, and restore the full rating only after the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, per MG-021.
